name: E-invoice: ZUGFeRD and Factur-X from one template
description: A German invoice whose data is one `_invoice` block. The template prints the block, and the same block becomes the XML inside the PDF: a ZUGFeRD / Factur-X invoice, a PDF/A-3 that carries `factur-x.xml`, validated against the rules of EN 16931 before it is delivered.
